title: Sidelink synchronisation information transmission for NR sidelink communication

entities.name: Sidelink Synchronisation Information Transmission
entities.description: Procedure for transmitting sidelink synchronisation information for NR sidelink communication, particularly in V2X scenarios with partial network coverage.

entities.name: SIB13/SIB14 acquisition
entities.description: System information block messages containing sidelink communication configuration parameters.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to configure sidelink communication parameters including synchronisation transmission.

entities.name: SLSS & MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: Sidelink synchronisation signal and master information block for sidelink communication synchronisation.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs sidelink synchronisation information transmission.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that provides configuration for sidelink synchronisation transmission.

relations.description: Sidelink synchronisation transmission procedure includes acquisition of SIB13/SIB14 system information.
Sidelink synchronisation transmission procedure includes RRC reconfiguration for sidelink parameters.
Sidelink synchronisation transmission procedure includes transmission of SLSS and MasterInformationBlockSidelink.
Network provides SIB13/SIB14 system information to UE for sidelink configuration.
Network sends RRCReconfiguration message to configure sidelink synchronisation transmission.
UE transmits SLSS and MasterInformationBlockSidelink for sidelink synchronisation.
